en: But it's all for the horses, so I don't mind.
A gentleman like you,
you can ride a horse, right?
Then you ought to learn how to care for
horses properly, too.
Want me to teach you?
Hey, you...
Come to think of it, did I ask your name?
, huh.
Feel free to come by my house any time.
It's just me and my son, after all.
Horses are valuable workers, after all.
People like me, who handle them properly,
are needed.
You're a face I don't see around here.
Yet you're dressed so conspicuously.
You'd best be careful, that's all.
What is there to be careful about, I wonder?
Don't do anything too conspicuous.
I'm just heading to the stables.
Somehow I'm already used to seeing you.
Like you've been here since forever.
You'd better not do anything too conspicuous.
Like you've always been here.
You stand out enough in that getup already,
note: msg 50437 is 4 lines because M0#1098 (slice 013) wraps to 2 lines; needs #1098 shortened

en: so don't go acting conspicuously, too.
Is there something you want with the horses?
If you do anything to my horses,
I won't let you get away with it.
Ranke... I'd like you to
note: Player (Christopher) speaking; split 'you' / 'to take on the role' to carry the Japanese sentence

en: take on the role of caretaker.
Of my precious Nosferatu...
note: No speaker tag; read as the player continuing the request (caretaker of the Nosferatu)

en: Please...
note: No speaker tag; read as the player

en: Ngh!
note: Unreferenced; a gasp (Ranke being bitten), same scene as #1154

en: Please bear with it for a little while.
, my master... As you command...
Ah, my joints ache all over...
You're... no, it's nothing.
Ah, good morning.
I'm off to the lake now.
You can catch fish at the lake, you know.
I'm going fishing at the lake again.
Won't you fish with me?
You're... no, never mind.
I went fishing at the lake,
but I caught nothing.
Something did seem to be biting, mind you.
This is the house of my son, Ios.
I just spend my days fishing,
like the old geezer I am.
You see, you can catch fish at the lake.
Let's go fishing together again.
Let's go to the lake together again.
Oh, you've come.
Neither my son nor his wife cares about me.
So neither you nor I need to worry about it.
You can't go on forever
leaving a fish hooked on the line.
A fish that's bitten has to be reeled in.
What are you doing?
Fishing.
Fishing? But I don't see a rod or a line anywhere.
It's fishing all the same.
(Hmph. What a peculiar old man.)
You can catch fish here.
Didn't you come here to fish?
I came, and I'm fishing.
note: worded to answer both 'Didn't you come here to fish?' and 'Aren't you fishing?' (msg 54726)

en: You seem to have neither rod nor line, though?
The fish scatter whenever you come around.
You there, what is your name?
. And you, old man?
A name like Otti doesn't matter,
you see. I'm only an old man.
, is it...
Old man, fishing without a rod,
I'm amazed you never get bored.
My rod? Why, it's floating over there.
Did you drop your rod in the lake?
I did drop it.
I didn't drop it by accident, mind you.
